description: Known-aptamer affinity calibration set for the EGARPS scoring chain (pilot P2). Primary analysis: within-target Spearman(native_probability, -log Kd) on role=binder entries with kd_nm; secondary: binder vs negative AUROC per target.
convention: DNA aptamers scored as RNA via T->U (same convention as known_aptamers.json/TBA).

entries.name: HD22 (HTDQ), exosite II DNA aptamer
entries.kd_method: nitrocellulose filter binding (Tasset 1997); SPR re-measurement 0.3 nM (Kretz 2015)
entries.reference: Tasset DM, Kubik MF, Steiner W. J Mol Biol 1997, 272:688-698. doi:10.1006/jmbi.1997.1275; Kretz CA et al. JBC 2015
entries.sequence_verification: AGGGC variant consistent with RCSB 4I7Y chain D (27-mer truncate, fetched 2026-08-03); full 29-mer = truncate + 5'-A + 3'-T

entries.name: HD22[27] truncate
entries.reference: Kretz CA et al. JBC 2015; co-crystal PDB 4I7Y (Russo Krauss et al.)
entries.sequence_verification: exact match to RCSB 4I7Y chain D fetched 2026-08-03

entries.name: Toggle-25t (2'-F RNA), exosite II
entries.kd_method: double-filter nitrocellulose filter binding, vs human thrombin (White 2001)
entries.reference: White R et al. Mol Ther 2001, 4:567-573. doi:10.1006/mthe.2001.0500
entries.sequence_verification: exact match to first 25 nt of RCSB 3DD2 chain B (26-mer incl. 3'-dT) fetched 2026-08-03

entries.name: NU172 (ARC2172), exosite I, Phase II
entries.kd_method: no primary-literature Kd (Archemix internal); functional IC50 5-10 ug/mL ecarin clotting (secondary: Keefe 2010 NRDD)
entries.reference: Keefe AD, Pai S, Ellington A. Nat Rev Drug Discov 2010, 9:537-550 (secondary)
entries.sequence_verification: multi-source consistent 26-mer (HAL theses/IJMS review); AUROC use only

entries.name: pegaptanib (Macugen, NX1838), unmodified base sequence
entries.kd_method: Tucker 1999 rhesus plasma assay; FDA review estimate ~0.2 nM; Lee 2005 PNAS ~0.05 nM
entries.reference: identical to pegaptanib.json anchor (Tucker 1999; Ruckman 1998 JBC 273:20556)

entries.name: PDGF-B aptamer '36t' (40-mer + 3'-idT in literature)
entries.sequence_verification: Aptagen entry verbatim (40 nt); 3'-idT cap excluded

entries.name: PDGF-B aptamer '41t' (45-mer, second clone family)
entries.kd_method: filter binding, same order of magnitude as 36t (Green 1996, via thesis citation — MEDIUM confidence)
entries.reference: Green LS et al. Biochemistry 1996, 35:14413-14424 (cited via Auburn thesis)
entries.sequence_verification: 45 nt; secondary-source transcription — flagged medium confidence

entries.name: D17.4 (anti-IgE, inhibits IgE-Fc-epsilon-RI)
entries.kd_method: filter binding, PBS + 1 mM MgCl2 pH 7.4 (Wiegand 1996)
entries.reference: Wiegand TW et al. J Immunol 1996, 157:221-230

entries.name: scrambled TBA (fixed seed 0) — disrupts G-tracts
entries.kd_method: literature: no detectable binding by SPR at uM detection limit (Bock 1992; HAL hal-01682623)
entries.reference: Bock LC et al. Nature 1992, 355:564-566; hal-01682623 (qualitative)
